S.b.meta.title: Lewydo™ brand — the heart, the splash, the menu signature, About us
S.b.meta.desc: How to recognise Lewydo, and everything a Lewydo game needs to show it the same way: the mark, colours, the splash screen, the menu signature, About us and the heartbeat — with the assets and the code.
S.b.nav.label: Brand page
S.b.hero.title: One heart, the same everywhere
S.b.hero.sub: How to recognise Lewydo — and everything a Lewydo game needs to show it the same way: the mark, its colours, the splash screen, the menu signature, About us and the heartbeat. The pictures and the code are right here, free to use in Lewydo projects.
S.b.hero.replay: Play the splash with its sound
S.b.rec.title: How to recognise Lewydo
S.b.rec.sub: A hand-drawn green heart shaped like a speech bubble, glowing mint on deep night blue, with a round white name under it. Wherever you see it, the game was made by the two of us, with love.
S.b.part.heart.d: Drawn by hand, shaped like a speech bubble: dark ink, a green fill with a chalky texture, a few splashes of paint.
S.b.part.glow.d: A soft mint glow (#6DF593) around the heart — it is part of the mark, never a separate effect.
S.b.part.name.d: «Lewydo» in Nunito Black, white, with a soft shadow.
S.b.part.slogan.d: «Love What You Do» — always in English, it is a trademark. Its bold letters spell the name.
S.b.part.line.d: A thin white line, 146 wide, that closes the mark.
S.b.spell: The name is made of the slogan: the bold letters of «Love What You Do» read **Lewydo**. That is why the slogan is never translated.
S.b.where.1.d: The splash screen: the Lockup appears, the heart beats once.
S.b.where.2.t: At the bottom of every menu
S.b.where.2.d: The signature pill — tap it to meet the studio.
S.b.where.3.d: The Lockup above a few words about the two of us.
S.b.where.4.d: [roshevasternin.github.io](/) — the heart built from the pixels of our games.
S.b.rules.title: Keep it the same
S.b.do.1: Use the pictures and the code of the kit **as they are**.
S.b.do.2: Keep the colours, the font and the proportions: the Lockup is **208×322**, the signature **24 + name**.
S.b.do.3: Let the heart **beat once** when the brand appears: the splash, About us (every time it opens), the menu pill.
S.b.do.4: Theme the **background and the ambient light** to your game — the mark stays the same on top of it.
S.b.do.5: Keep it on a dark background (#0E1024 or your game's own dark night).
S.b.dont.1: Redraw, recolour, stretch, squash, rotate or add effects to the mark.
S.b.dont.2: Translate the slogan or set the name in another font.
S.b.dont.3: Loop the heartbeat — a logo that blinks forever distracts from the game.
S.b.dont.4: Put it on a light or busy background.

S.b.games.title: The splash, the loader credits, About us, the menu signature
S.b.games.sub: The same four places in every Lewydo game, 360×800. The mark and its numbers never change; the background and the light may follow the game — try it:
S.b.ph.loader.d: Right after the splash, at the bottom of the game's loader (never on the splash itself): who made the game, on what, and which version. The version is the app's own, so it changes by itself with every release.
S.b.ph.splash.d: The first screen of every game, ≈ 4 s: the mark arrives, then the heartbeat with the Lewydo sound, then the game's loader.
S.b.ph.about.d: The heart beats every time About us opens. The text, the buttons and the back button are each game's own; the mark is the same.
S.b.mn.title: YOUR GAME
S.b.ph.menu.d: A quiet signature, not an ad: centred, 34 px from the bottom. Tap → About us (the pill presses to 0.96). It beats once when the menu appears — tap it here.
S.b.num.1: **Lockup 208×322**: logo 208×208 (the glow fills it, the heart 140×140 in the middle) · name 208×74 · slogan 208×19 · line 146×1, 20 below
S.b.num.2: **Splash**: the heart arrives 0.15→0.85 s · the name 0.55→1.1 and the slogan 0.85→1.4 come into focus · the line opens 1.15→1.85 · the finale: a breath in at 2.0, lub at 2.17, dub at 2.45, two waves of light · the sound from 2.09 · 3.8 s → the game
S.b.num.3: **About us**: Lockup at top 108 · text at 456, width 312 · buttons 296×52 at 584 and 682 · the site address at 648 · © at 764

S.b.num.5: **Loader credits**: Powered by LibGDX · Developed by Lewydo™ · Version + the app's version — Inter Medium 10, line height 12, white 25 %, centred; a 360×36 block 28 above the bottom (+ safe area); English in every language
S.b.hb.title: One beat, when the brand appears
S.b.hb.sub: The heart and its glow beat **separately** — a quick «lub-dub» — exactly **once**: when the splash shows, every time About us opens, when the menu pill appears. Never in a loop. With «reduce motion» on, it doesn't beat at all.
S.b.dl.title: The brand kit
S.b.dl.sub: The pictures are the ones from Figma that the games use: PNG @3x of the sizes above, sharp on any screen. Apps take the PNGs or the whole LibGDX atlas; websites can take the WebP copies of the same pictures.
S.b.dl.zip.d: Pictures (PNG + WebP), the sound, the LibGDX atlas, the Kotlin and web code, brand.json
S.b.c.heart.d: brand_front (the heart) over brand_back (the glow) — two pictures, so they can beat separately. Logo box 208, heart 140.
S.b.c.name: The name
S.b.c.line.d: 146×1, 20 below the slogan; on the splash it opens from the middle.
S.b.c.lockup.d: One transparent picture — for stores, videos and slides. In a game, build it from the parts (the splash animates them).
S.b.c.pill.d: The menu pill from Figma, one transparent picture. In a game, build it from the parts, so the heart can beat.
S.b.c.atlas.d: All five pictures in one texture — assets/atlas/, EnumAtlas.BRAND.
S.b.c.code.d: LibGDX (Kotlin) for the games, CSS for the web — the splash, the heartbeat, the pill.
S.b.dev.title: Put Lewydo into a new game
S.b.dev.sub: Everything below lives in [the site’s repository → brand/](https://github.com/RoShevasternin/roshevasternin.github.io/tree/main/brand) and in [brand.json](/brand/brand.json) (all the numbers, the texts in every language of our games and the file addresses — for code and for Claude).
S.b.step.1.d: Copy `kit/atlas/brand.atlas` + `brand.png` into `assets/atlas/` and `kit/sound/lewydo-heartbeat.ogg` into `assets/sound/`; the atlas regions: `brand_back`, `brand_front`, `lewydo`, `slogan`, `brand_line` (your `assetsBrand`, `EnumAtlas.BRAND`).
S.b.step.2.d: Copy `LewydoHeartbeat.kt` (package `com.lewydo.brand`) and `BrandScreen.kt`, `ABrandGroup.kt`, `ABrandLogo.kt`; replace `yourgame` with your package. They use the Lewydo LibGDX base (AdvancedScreen, AConstraintLayout, AAutoLayout).
S.b.step.3.d: Start the game on `BrandScreen`: ≈ 4 s — the mark arrives, the heartbeat and the Lewydo sound, then `LoaderScreen`. Connect `soundVolume()` to your game's sound settings: 1.0 at their usual level, quieter only if the player turns sounds down.
S.b.step.4.d: The pill at the bottom of the menu (centred, 34 px from the bottom) → About us; one beat when the menu appears.
S.b.step.5.d: The Lockup at top 108, the studio text (English is the reference; every language of our games is in brand.json), «Our website» → `https://roshevasternin.github.io/` with the address under it, «Our games on Google Play» → our developer page, «© 2026 Lewydo™». One beat every time it opens.
S.b.step.6.d: Theme the background and the light behind the mark to your game — never the mark itself.
S.b.prompt: For Claude in another project — copy this (Claude reads it in English)
S.b.foot: © 2026 Lewydo™ · Love What You Do. The Lewydo mark is ours: use it only in Lewydo projects, and only as this kit shows it.
S.b.hb.finale: In the splash the beat is the **finale**: the whole mark arrives first, then a breath in, a big lub and a dub, two waves of light — and the Lewydo sound.
S.b.snd.title: The sound of Lewydo
S.b.snd.sub: Only the heart: two soft, round heartbeats — the first stronger, the second quieter — right on the beats of the mark. No melody, nothing ringing: a calm, warm hello.
S.b.snd.r1: Once per launch, with the splash — never in a loop.
S.b.snd.r2: At full volume when the game's sounds are at their usual level (gain 1.0); the player's slider may only make it quieter; sounds off — silence.
S.b.snd.r3: Never change it, cut it or play it under music.
S.b.snd.r4: A web page may play it only after a tap; a splash that opens by itself stays silent.
S.b.snd.r5: One file everywhere: every game, its web prototype and its site play this very file, byte for byte — made for phone speakers (its own overtones, peaks at −1 dBFS) — so Lewydo sounds the same wherever you hear it.
S.b.say.note: «Lewydo» is «Love What You Do» said quickly: three syllables, **Lev-why-do**.
S.b.c.sound.d: The heartbeat: .ogg for LibGDX, .mp3 for the web, .wav — the master.
S.b.dont.5: Play the sound in a loop, louder than the game, or when the player has turned sounds off.
S.b.work.title: Prototype first, then the game
S.b.work.lead: This is how every Lewydo game is made.
S.b.work.1: **New things start in the prototype.** A screen, a mechanic, a text or a number is made and tried in the game's web prototype first — it's quick to test in a browser.
S.b.work.2: **The game is ported from it.** The game (LibGDX: Android, later iOS) takes everything from the prototype, numbers and words one to one: the prototype is the reference.
S.b.work.3: **Never the other way round.** Something new made only in the game is unknown to the prototype, and the two drift apart. Even a fix: first in the prototype, then in the game.
